episodes.title: The Skeptic's Guide to Starting a Cult
episodes.description: How do cults form? Why do people join cults? It doesn't actually take a charismatic cult leader, but a self-propagating dogma which plays on basic human needs and vulnerabilities. Jonestown, Heaven's Gate, and the Branch Davidians weren't actually typical when it comes to cult structure, and larger groups like Mormonism, Jehovah's Witnesses, and Scientology show signs of more deliberate, sustainable mind-controlling structure. episodes.title: Ex-Jehovah's Witness Visits JW World Headquarters
episodes.description: Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/GeneticallyModifiedSkeptic Uploaded 03-08-19 PayPal: https://www.paypal.me/GMSkeptic The Jehovah's Witnesses are a cult, and like any cult, they have a compound. The Jehovah's Witness world headquarters at Warwick, New York, is very particular about the way it's portrayed in media, wishing to control as much circulating information about it as possible. Owen of the channel Telltale is an ex-Jehovah's Witness who was disfellowshipped (shunned) at 18 and cut off from his family. He's now a proud apostate and activist against the Watchtower Society. He and I visited the headquarters posing as JWs in hopes of simply learning what it was like, but our story took a turn as soon as we arrived.
